semanticDecisions: a source outside the trigram band cannot use the gate the plan feeds, so no plan is asked for it: short sources, the common case, never touch the plan cache

inside the band the plan is still built on the needle's first use: measured, a plan built on the repeat use instead lost the gate whenever the 256-slot cache thrashed, which on 16384-unit sources cost more than the plan (1,159 ns against 102); the plan is cheaper now, not later

the plan drops its forward tables: since A21 the flat-haystack forward search and since A35 the M3-source searches are not reached, so only the reverse table (the A21 reverse search of a long needle) and the trigram facts (the gate) remain; the retained-bytes ceiling follows
the per-unit searches over an M3 source and the flat-haystack forward search are removed rather than kept dead
